text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival 
has arrived. The academy is open to the 
public today for all sorts of events, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... T-To think I'd end up entering a 
marathon~...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"No problem at all! For Rice-chan, it'll 
be a piece of cake, right?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As a stayer, Rice-san, you can 
absolutely, definitely go the distance!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it. Umm, that's not what 
I mean...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you really are running in it! 
McQueen-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, even if it is merely a school event, 
I have no intention of slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~! So cool!! As expected of the 
'Actor', the strongest stayer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
J-Jeez! Who on earth came up with a title 
like that...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho~, as expected of the Umamusume 
aiming for a 3-peat (provisional) in the 
Spring Tenno Sho! Truly on another level~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Geez, not you too, Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... This is a competition. And a 
long-distance race, no less."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Please let me concentrate.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, alright. ...I'll just watch without 
getting in the way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't account for this at all...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However, this is a good opportunity. We 
can run a simulation for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon-san!? How's your conditionâ

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No problem. I have already transitioned to 
the rehabilitation program.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I heard, Rice-san. That you plan to defeat 
McQueen-san at the upcoming Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am looking forward to it immensely. To 
seeing just how much you have grown.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time is finite. Two minutes 
remain until the start. I suggest we 
finish our preparations promptly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it that time already...!? I... I'm 
off!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...A-And also! Bourbon-san! Please watch 
me, watch how strong Rice has become!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the marathon in which Rice Shower 
was participating began...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, the final hill!! Dashing up the 
slope, the first one to come into view 
is—here she comes!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's McQueen! McQueen! McQueen crosses the 
finish line in a brilliant first place!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The favored Rice Shower is... falling far 
behind, finishing in 8th place?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... ...No way, how could 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Rice was nowhere near reaching it. At 
this rate, I'll never...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Rice Showeeer! Great job today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*... Did you find 
Rice-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, yes. They should have been right 
here until just a moment ago, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I have... to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The favored Rice Shower... fought hard, 
but finished in 2nd place!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Great work out there, Rice-san!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, Rice-chan, you're amazing! Second 
place! Let's celebrate together!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you. ...But......

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The way Rice is right now... It's not 
enough at all...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...S-Sorry. No celebration necessary."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because next time... I don't want to let 
anyone down...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh, w-wait up, Rice-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I have... to do my best.
